label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled param flows to host variable, which is used in DNS resolution (line 13) AND directly in URL construction for outbound fetch (line 24). While there is a private IP range check after DNS resolution, this does not mitigate the SSRF since attackers can supply hostnames resolving to external IPs (CNAME chains, DNS spoofing scenarios). The resolved sink value at line 24 is http://+host where host=param=user input.

evidence.note: User param flows to host, used in DNS resolution (L13) and URL fetch (L24)
